summary: Part 1 of the brief-3 integration, done while validation still builds in the same tree. (1) Time API: tf is required at the five §14.9.6 shims; the 19 Pacific-bound lib/time names and the deprecated exports insideCalifornia, NOT_FIRE_SPECIFIC, fmtStatusTime, feed topic 'calfire', useCalfire, fill_from_calfire and overpass.la_time are deleted; check-time-api on web/src: 0 deprecated uses, 0 America/Los_Angeles literals. (2) Contracts: the (R) fields are required in contracts.py (LiveStatus.detections_24h, IncidentListResponse.sources, FireWeatherResponse.states_checked/alert_states, FireWeatherAlert.time_zone), in web/src/api/types.ts (the five IncidentSummary fields, sources, detections_24h), web/src/official/types.ts and web/src/extras/types.ts (new EvacSource, states, zone props); the parity test covers the official shapes. (3) test_api.py build-gate hand-off done (exact 14.2 texts at the API, alias and 422 cases). (4) Review leftovers fixed: local officials' alerts outside the lower 48 answer 'not checked' from the backend (N2), the location card lists every message of the point's own box answer (N3), an open fire's data sources credit TIGERweb, NTAD and NWCG (us-web N1), a past record's update time keeps its year in the Public summary. (5) Two bugs found in the browser checks and fixed: picking an unprepared fire's card (Little Giant, WA) opened the nearby prepared Lower Sugarloaf Fire instead (zoom focus now held for the card's flight); the location card at a past time in a state without an evacuation feed said 'not shown for past dates' instead of 'not available in this state'. (6) CONTRACT §14 gains '14.0 as built' to '14.14 as built' sub-headings folding the four wave-1 notes, plus the §14.5 several-records case, §14.7 MultiPolygon and county matches, and the decision to keep the hourly re-check of a daily Open-Meteo block (§14.12.2); SPEC follows. (7) Verified in the browser at 1440x900 and 390x844 in Public and Command (33 screenshots, each viewed); gates pass. Validation's files were not touched; what needs them is in 'part2'.

contract_deviations: IncidentSummary's five (R) fields keep a Python default (old manifests are filled on read) and are always dumped; TS requires them; the parity test lists them as FILLED_ON_READ (CONTRACT 14.1 as built).
A NIFC WFIGS summary without record_issuer is filled with the 14.2 issuer text on read ('<code> via NIFC WFIGS', else 'NIFC WFIGS (IRWIN)'); before, it stayed null.
SkillEntry.growth_sorensen stays optional (forecast manifests built before brief 3 lack it).

The brief-2 official TS envelope fields kind / incident_id / caveats may stay optional in web/src/official/types.ts (parity test ENVELOPE_LENIENT); everything else of the brief-3 official shapes matches Python field for field.
§14.12.2: the hourly re-check of a daily Open-Meteo block (us-pipeline review R3) is accepted and written into the contract.
§14.7 additions: local alerts outside the lower 48 answer state_not_available with both channels not_checked; MapFlyTo.source gains 'fire-card' (§14.11 as built).
OfficialBlock.fireWeather is not renamed to 'lines' (optional in PLAN-3; left for a later brief).
known_issues: A search submitted within the first second or two after page load (before the map controller exists) can be dropped: MapController takes the current mapFlyTo nonce at construction (web/src/map/mapController.ts:286), so a request made earlier is never flown (seen once with '59601 MT' run by a script at load; the same search a few seconds later frames Helena). Minor; a fix would apply a pending request younger than a few seconds.

Forensic screenshots time out under swiftshader in this container (page.screenshot exceeds 30 s while the 3D scene renders); us-web's review has Forensic screenshots of Eaton and fixture-east. Not a functional finding.
Each map page load aborts one /api/official/fire-weather request (net::ERR_ABORTED in shot.mjs): a superseded fetch when the clock/zone settles; no user-visible effect.
Fire-3d's own IEM-archive limiter can answer 429 during many fire openings within a minute; the panel then says 'Unavailable right now' (honest, never 'none').
ZIP areas are described 'near' the nearest gazetteer place to the ZCTA centroid ('ZIP 59601, MT near Rimini' for a Helena ZIP).
The Public compact summary has no local officials' alerts line (optional item of us-official, not done; the full Official now block, the feed and the location card have them).
Validation's in-progress bundles (Island Creek 'building', Lower Sugarloaf, Madre, Emigrant) are on disk and appear as prepared fires on the map.
